tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Validate a UBL 2.1 invoice: every rule violation with a plain-English fix, the UBL path of the field and, for amount errors, the correct value. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (network eip155:8453); without a payment it returns the payment requirements. Only real invoices are charged. If the repo

tools.name: fix_invoice
tools.description: Repair the invoice automatically and return the corrected XML: county/sector/country/currency/unit codes, date formats, VAT-id prefixes, decimals, totals and VAT recomputed from the lines. Lists every change (field, old, new) and re-validates the result. Paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only if so

tools.name: generate_invoice
tools.description: Create a complete Romanian e-Factura (UBL 2.1 CIUS-RO XML) from simple data: invoice number, dates, seller and buyer CUI, lines (name, quantity, unit, price without VAT, VAT rate e.g. 21 or 11), optional IBAN. Company names, addresses, county codes, Bucharest sectors and VAT status are filled from A

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Romanian company data by CUI (fiscal code) from ANAF, already in e-Factura form: legal name, VAT id (RO… only for VAT payers), trade register number, address with county as ISO code (RO-CJ) and Bucharest city as SECTOR1..6, plus flags: inactive, VAT on collection, e-Factura registry. Free.

tools.name: validate_invoice_free
tools.description: Same report as validate_invoice, free: 3 calls per day per client IP. When the quota is used up, switch to validate_invoice.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explain one business rule by its id (e.g. BR-CO-15, BR-RO-110, PEPPOL-EN16931-R001): official text, plain-English fix and where the field lives in UBL. Free.
